subject: Bare block as sub tail loses its value (both pipelines)
description: `sub f { my @x=(4,5,6); { @x } }` returns empty in scalar AND list context in BOTH v1 and v2 (perl: 3 / 4 5 6). The bare block lowers as a loop-once (block nil ...) whose tail statement is treated as void, so the block's value is dropped. Found s288 while probing tail handling for the void-wrap hoist (task #60). An if/else tail (`sub g { if(1){ @x } }`) works correctly — only the bare-block compound drops the value. Fix would be threading tail_ctx into _lower_bare_block (v2) / the equivalent v1 path, keeping loop-once last/next/redo semantics. Probe saved in scratchpad bareblocktail.pl.
